illustrae.name: "Generate a two-panel data figure. Left panel: a vertical bar chart showing AI recruitment market value in two years — 2023 ($661M) and 2030 ($1.12B projected) — with a dashed trend arrow between bars. Right panel: a horizontal bar chart showing three employer-reported outcomes — time-to-hire reduction (50%), cost savings (66%), and a third benchmark if available. Both charts use zero-based Y-axes. Label each bar with its value. Include a small note distinguishing 'reported' from 'verified' outcomes. Layout: side-by-side horizontal. Style: clean academic line diagram, white background, no decorative elements, Arial 12pt labels."

illustrae.name: FIGURE 2 — Neuroblastoma (Section 34.1) Target: INRG Risk Stratification Diagram Figure Architect Prompt:  "Medical infographic showing the International Neuroblastoma Risk Group (INRG) stratification system. Four-tier pyramid or horizontal bar chart showing: Very Low Risk (>85% 5-year EFS), Low Risk (75–85%), Intermediate Risk (50–75%), High Risk (<50%). Include key variables listed alongside each tier: patient age, MYCN amplification status, chromosome 11q deletion, DNA ploidy. Color-coded gradient from green (very low) to red (high risk). Flat vector diagram. Scientific oncology textbook style. Clean, labeled, no decorative elements."

illustrae.name: FIGURE 3 — Wilms Tumor (Section 34.2) Target Diagnostic Marker: Triphasic Histology Pattern Figure Architect Prompt:  "Histopathology diagram of Wilms tumor (nephroblastoma) showing the classic triphasic pattern. Three clearly labeled compartments within one panel: (1) Blastema — small round blue cells with active mitotic figures; (2) Epithelium — early tubular formations and differentiating glomeruli-like structures; (3) Stroma — loose mesenchymal tissue, may include muscle or cartilage. Arrange as a schematic pie-section or side-by-side panel. Include a second small diagram showing anaplasia: hyperchromatic pleomorphic nuclei three times larger than adjacent cells with abnormal mitotic figures. Label all structures. Scientific medical diagram style. High-contrast histopathology illustration. White background. Flat vector. Educational textbook quality."
